# Rule-to-Evidence Map

Use this map to keep a conclusion tied to the source that constrains it and to the example that illustrates its scope. It does not convert an example or a clean instrumented run into a universal proof.

| Rule                                                                                                    | Primary source scope                                                                                                          | Worked example                                                                                                                     | Evidence limit                                                                                                |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Callback work and output obligations follow the selected host lifecycle and buffer contract.            | CLAP plugin, audio-buffer, audio-port, thread-pool, and process headers; JUCE and PortAudio documentation.                    | [Two inputs, three outputs, and a worker](../comprehensive/audio-thread-rules.md#example-two-inputs-three-outputs-and-a-worker).   | The example covers its declared layout and bounds only.                                                       |
| Ordinary shared payload needs ownership or a synchronization protocol before concurrent access.         | C++ data-race rules and Rust atomic documentation.                                                                            | [Three display blocks](../comprehensive/lock-free-buffers.md#example-three-display-blocks).                                        | SPSC does not cover a second producer or an unbounded payload operation.                                      |
| Acquire and release edges authorize payload observation and reuse only when the protocol connects them. | C++ data-race rules, Rust ordering documentation, and Zig 0.16 documentation.                                                 | [Rust AtomicU8 slot states](../comprehensive/memory-ordering.md#example-rust-atomicu8-slot-states).                                | The stated Rust version and target do not establish a proof for another language or target.                   |
| A tool result applies only to reached, instrumented paths and a control needs its intended diagnostic.  | ThreadSanitizer, AddressSanitizer, UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer, RealtimeSanitizer, and Function Effect Analysis documentation. | [A control record, not a general result](../comprehensive/verifying-concurrency.md#example-a-control-record-not-a-general-result). | A clean run does not prove all schedules, paths, lifetimes, or deadline bounds.                               |
| Released IDs and host transitions remain compatibility contracts.                                       | CLAP parameter, state, latency, and port headers; VST3 and Audio Unit parameter documentation; pinned clap-wrapper source.    | [Preset with pending latency](../comprehensive/parameters-and-state.md#example-preset-with-pending-latency).                       | The AUv2 mapping is pinned to one wrapper revision and needs a host fixture for compatibility evidence.       |
| Event timing, output status, automation curves, and smoothing follow the selected format's contract.    | CLAP event, process, and tail headers; VST3 queue, Audio Unit render, and JUCE smoothing documentation.                       | [Bounded two-block trace](../comprehensive/events-and-timing.md#example-bounded-two-block-trace).                                  | The trace defines one policy and does not promise delivery after a host stops offering output opportunities.  |
| A host-independent boundary needs a check that rejects the prohibited dependency or signature.          | The selected build system's dependency policy and signature check; fosforo interface assertion as a scoped case study.        | [Enforced Rust core boundary](../comprehensive/the-pure-core-seam.md#example-enforced-rust-core-boundary).                         | Directory layout or core-vector success alone does not establish adapter correctness or transitive isolation. |
